tools.name: ask_momentic
tools.description: Asks Ask Momentic a question and returns its answer, written by AI from momenticmarketing.com pages, with the Momentic pages it is based on as sources. Use it for questions about Momentic (services, Atlas, the team, case studies, pricing) and about SEO and AI search topics Momentic publishes researc

tools.name: get_brand_overview
tools.description: Returns the canonical AI-readable description of Momentic from /llms.txt. Use for authoritative brand info, positioning, services, and contact.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists pages on momenticmarketing.com from sitemap.xml. Optional `section` filter: team, case-studies, capabilities, services, blog, seo-news, content-academy, google-updates, blog-categories, careers, about, contact, pricing.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetches a Momentic page as Markdown (uses Cloudflare's Markdown for Agents). Pass an absolute path like "/team/jane-doe" or a full momenticmarketing.com URL.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across every page on momenticmarketing.com (blog posts, research, the Google update tracker with each update's status and dates, case studies, Content Academy guides, Atlas, team pages, careers, the SEO news feed item by item, and Momentic's agent tools and skills), including pages

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Probes a domain root for site-wide AI-discovery signals: /llms.txt; /robots.txt parsed per RFC 9309 for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, GoogleOther, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, meta-exte

tools.name: check_bots
tools.description: Probes a URL with AI crawler user agents, using the operators' current documented strings (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, GoogleOther, Google-Agent, CCBot, Applebot, meta-externalagent, meta-externalfetcher, Amzn-SearchB

tools.name: parse_freshness_signals
tools.description: Pure parser (no fetching). Given HTML plus optional response headers and a sitemap entry for the same URL, extracts every freshness marker on the page — HTTP Last-Modified, sitemap lastmod, JSON-LD dateModified/datePublished (including @graph), OpenGraph article:modified_time/published_time, meta up

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Pure HTML parser. Given a single page's HTML and its baseUrl, returns every <a href> resolved to absolute, separated into internal vs external by host, with cleaned anchor text, rel attribute, and nofollow flag. Skips fragments, mailto:, tel:, javascript:, and empty hrefs. Designed to feed compute_l

tools.name: compute_link_graph
tools.description: Pure graph computation over a crawled page set. Input: an array of {url, internalLinks: [{href, anchor}, ...], title?, bodyText?}. Returns orphan pages (in-degree 0, excluding the homepage), hubs (top-N by in-degree), authorities (top-N by out-edges to hubs), PageRank-lite ranking, anchor-diversity

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Resolves a brand/topic/person to a structured entity record built from Wikidata + Wikipedia (free APIs, no auth). Pass exactly one of: `name` (search by string), `qid` (Wikidata Q-number to skip search), or `wikipediaTitle` (resolves to QID via the article's wikibase_item). Returns: qid, label, desc

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, search, analyze_site, check_bots, parse_freshness_signals, lookup_entity · Private data: get_brand_overview, list_pages, analyze_site, check_bots, lookup_entity · Public sink: ask_momentic.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, search, analyze_site, check_bots, parse_freshness_signals, lookup_entity · Private data: get_brand_overview, list_pages, analyze_site, check_bots, lookup_entity · Public sink: ask_momentic

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
